name: Kampai Sushi
blocked: Own site (kampaisushi.menu11.com, all paths) returns literal body NO SITE FOUND -- platform/tenant page is dead. Yelp (both the old Kampai Sushi RENOVATED listing and the newer Kyodai 23 Sushi listing at the same address) returns a bot-blocked stub (776 bytes) to curl, so photos/menu tab could not be read. Grubhub and Sirved pages returned no price data (JS shell / no prices in HTML). Only reachable priced source is the DoorDash marketplace listing, but it fails two checks: (1) markup test -- dividing its 91 prices by 1.10 lands 87/91 (95.6%) on round or .95/.99/.50-ending values, a textbook uniform delivery surcharge per playbook rule 6, so these are not wall prices; (2) completeness -- its Sashimi section only has 24/30/36pc party-platter assortments and there is no per-piece Sushi/Nigiri section at all, while web search (unverified against raw bytes) suggests the current menu has a "Sushi (2pcs) & Sashimi (6pcs)" section plus Kyodai Ramen, Hand Rolls, Non Rice Rolls, Tempura Rolls, Noodles and Beverages sections not present in this capture -- a sushi house missing single-piece nigiri reads as a core-section gap, not just an adjunct. Also unresolved: search results say the address has been under new management as "Kyodai 23 Sushi" since Nov 2023 (two separate Yelp business pages exist for the address), which per playbook could make Kampai Sushi a closed predecessor rather than the current operator -- needs a browser to check Yelp business status (open/permanently closed) and to view Kyodai 23s own menu to determine whether it is a rebrand of the same business (address matches exactly either way) or a true successor. Needs: a Chrome-equipped pass on the two Yelp pages to resolve business-continuity and read menu photos, plus the restaurants own current ordering platform if Kyodai 23 has one.

name: Santorini
notes: Work list had no website; identified as Santorini Island Grill, 10545 Scripps Poway Pkwy Ste E, San Diego (work list address matches street number/name; suite D vs E is a minor discrepancy, same plaza). The restaurants apparent own domain santoriniislandgrill.net is a hijacked/spun-up AI blog farm (title "Recipes, Stories, & More", posts like craft-an-irresistible-bbq-menu-for-your-restaurant) -- not used. Its real own ordering platform is NetWaiter (santoriniislandgrill1.netwaiter.com/san-diego/menu/): its embedded JSON-LD prices are all placeholder 0.00, and 42 of the ~68 items rendered in the HTML table itself also show literal /usr/bin/bash.00, including flagship items (Gyros Plate, Souvlaki Plate, Zorbas Platter, Santorini Platter) -- prices stripped from the widget per the known trap. The ~24 NetWaiter items that DID carry real numbers turned out to be stale: overlapping items are 60-75% cheaper than the current Grubhub/allmenus figures (e.g. Veggie Combo Platter .99 there vs 1.29 here, Spanakopita Plate .49 vs 1.29) -- a gap far beyond any delivery surcharge, so treated as an old/abandoned NetWaiter catalog and discarded entirely rather than blended. Direct Grubhub, Uber Eats and DoorDash marketplace pages all returned bot-blocked shells to curl (no prices, no JSON-LD). Used allmenus.com instead, whose menu page is explicitly Grubhubs own data surfaced through an allmenus mirror (grubhub-owned-menu-properties links, matching phone/address) -- read via its embedded schema.org Menu JSON-LD, not the visible HTML. This is effectively single-sourced (Grubhub data, no independent second platform reachable), so confidence is medium rather than high; no systematic markup divisor found across the 74 prices. 8 header/build-your-own label rows with no standalone offer (e.g. base "Greek Salads", pack names) were dropped per the no-price-no-row rule; their priced variants (e.g. "Topped with Gyros Meat" 1.25) were kept.
